# A02 · 并发：task / gather

# 【优先课注释】Async / LLM 落地
# 课题：A02: create_task 与 gather
# 建议：先通读注释 → 运行看输出 → 改一处参数再跑 → 对照书本加深。
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# --- 导入依赖 ---
import asyncio
import time


# --- 异步函数 fetch_fake：注意 await 点，勿在此写阻塞 IO ---
async def fetch_fake(name: str, delay: float) -> str:
    await asyncio.sleep(delay)
    return f"{name}-ok"


# --- 异步函数 main：注意 await 点，勿在此写阻塞 IO ---
async def main() -> None:
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    results = await asyncio.gather(
        fetch_fake("A", 0.4),
        fetch_fake("B", 0.4),
        fetch_fake("C", 0.4),
    )
    print(results, f"elapsed={time.perf_counter() - t0:.2f}s")


# --- 脚本入口：从这里开始执行 ---
if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
